turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail:
· AI says:
A few days without tracking usually means your order hasn’t reached shipping yet—annoying, but not necessarily alarming. It may be Pending Payment, Processing, We’re Packing Your Parcel, or Left Our Warehouse. You’ll receive a dispatch email once shipped; tracking then appears in your account and via the courier’s reference number. International delivery estimates include packing time. Check order history if payment is uncertain.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
· AI says:

Great question—here’s the no-nonsense tracking route! After dispatch, check your order page or dispatch email. Use your reference number:

Most deliveries: Skynet’s tracking page → enter LBWWXXXXXXXXX (for example) → “Track Shipment(s)”.
Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE: DHL’s tracking page → Shipment Reference → select the month’s first and last day.

Not shipped yet? The link appears after dispatch in your email or order-status page.

Sources
